test_select_exclude: test SELECT * EXCLUDE and SELECT * EXCEPT wildcard options to remove columns from a Polars DataFrame SQL query
test_select_exclude_order_by: test SELECT * EXCLUDE combined with ORDER BY clause to sort excluded-column results in Polars DataFrame SQL
test_ilike: test SELECT * ILIKE wildcard option to select columns matching a SQL pattern in Polars DataFrame SQL
test_select_rename: test SELECT * RENAME option to rename columns in a Polars DataFrame SQL query
test_select_replace: test SELECT * REPLACE option to replace column expressions in a Polars DataFrame SQL query
test_select_rename_exclude_sort: test combined SELECT * EXCLUDE, RENAME, and ORDER BY clauses in Polars DataFrame SQL
test_select_wildcard_errors: test error handling for conflicting SELECT * wildcard options in Polars DataFrame SQL
